description: Land Acquisition - Omaragolla Ibbangamuwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Warakapitiya, Welipitiya D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically declaring the government's intention to acquire specific parcels of land for public purposes (construction projects). It contains detailed descriptions of the lands to be acquired, including lot numbers, land names, extents, locations, and claimant information. The content focuses entirely on land/property matters without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories, making it a clear Land Gazette (Type 4).
